description: This file defines an abstract Data Access Object (DAO) class 'BaseDao' which provides common database query functionalities such as counting, sorting, pagination, and combined sorting and pagination, using Doctrine ORM in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: BaseDao
classes.description: An abstract class providing generic database operations such as counting, sorting, and pagination, intended to be extended by specific DAO implementations.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of records resulting from the provided QueryBuilder.

methods.name: setSortingParams
methods.description: Applies sorting based on the provided filter parameters to the QueryBuilder.

methods.name: setPaginationParams
methods.description: Applies pagination (limit and offset) to the QueryBuilder based on the filter parameters.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Applies both sorting and pagination to the QueryBuilder.
